title: Limited evaluation on diverse tasks
description: The Transformer is evaluated only on machine translation (two language pairs) and English constituency parsing. The authors state they plan to apply the model to other tasks in future work, acknowledging the limited task scope.
canonical_description: model evaluated on a limited set of tasks beyond translation and parsing

evidence.anchor: plan to apply them to other tasks
evidence.quote: We are excited about the future of attention-based models and plan to apply them to other tasks.
